# Parse data from the page text files
# Data from treasury_bulletin_2015_09_page_18.txt for 2010-2014
data_2010_2014 = {
    2010: (2161728, 3455931),
    2011: (2302495, 3598086),
    2012: (2449092, 3538447),
    2013: (2773979, 3454254),
    2014: (3020847, 3504199),
}

# Data from treasury_bulletin_2020_09_page_21.txt for 2015-2019
data_2015_2019 = {
    2015: (3248722, 3687623),
    2016: (3266689, 3854101),
    2017: (3314893, 3980720),
    2018: (3328745, 4107741),
    2019: (3462195, 4446583),
}

# Data from treasury_bulletin_2025_09_page_22.txt for 2020-2024 (actual values, not estimates)
data_2020_2024 = {
    2020: (3419955, 6551871),
    2021: (4045980, 6818159),
    2022: (4896119, 6271508),
    2023: (4439283, 6134433),
    2024: (4918737, 6751553),
}

# Combine all data
all_data = {**data_2010_2014, **data_2015_2019, **data_2020_2024}

# Sort by year and create lists
years = sorted(all_data.keys())
receipts = [all_data[y][0] for y in years]
outlays = [all_data[y][1] for y in years]

print("Fiscal Year Data (receipts, outlays):")
for y, r, o in zip(years, receipts, outlays):
    print(f"{y}: Receipts={r:,}, Outlays={o:,}")

# Now apply HP filter
from statsmodels.tsa.filters.hp_filter import hpfilter

# Apply HP filter with lambda=100
receipts_cycle, receipts_trend = hpfilter(receipts, lamb=100)
outlays_cycle, outlays_trend = hpfilter(outlays, lamb=100)

print("\n\nHP Filter Results (trend components):")
print("Year\tReceipts Trend\tOutlays Trend")
for i, y in enumerate(years):
    print(f"{y}\t{receipts_trend.iloc[i]:,.2f}\t{outlays_trend.iloc[i]:,.2f}")

# Calculate actual balance and structural balance
print("\n\nBalance Calculations:")
print("Year\tActual Balance\tStructural Balance")
for i, y in enumerate(years):
    actual_balance = receipts[i] - outlays[i]
    structural_balance = receipts_trend.iloc[i] - outlays_trend.iloc[i]
    print(f"{y}\t{actual_balance:,.2f}\t{structural_balance:,.2f}")

# Get FY 2024 values
fy_2024_idx = years.index(2024)
actual_balance_2024 = receipts[fy_2024_idx] - outlays[fy_2024_idx]
structural_balance_2024 = receipts_trend.iloc[fy_2024_idx] - outlays_trend.iloc[fy_2024_idx]
absolute_gap = abs(actual_balance_2024 - structural_balance_2024)

print(f"\n\nFY 2024 Results:")
print(f"Actual Balance: {actual_balance_2024:,.2f} (receipts - outlays)")
print(f"Structural Balance: {structural_balance_2024:,.2f} (trend receipts - trend outlays)")
print(f"Absolute Gap: {absolute_gap:,.2f}")

# Round to nearest whole number (millions)
actual_balance_2024_rounded = round(actual_balance_2024)
structural_balance_2024_rounded = round(structural_balance_2024)
absolute_gap_rounded = round(absolute_gap)

print(f"\n\nRounded to nearest whole number (millions):")
print(f"Actual Balance: {actual_balance_2024_rounded:,}")
print(f"Structural Balance: {structural_balance_2024_rounded:,}")
print(f"Absolute Gap: {absolute_gap_rounded:,}")

# Output format: [actual, structural, gap]
print(f"\n\nFinal Answer Format:")
print(f"[{actual_balance_2024_rounded}, {structural_balance_2024_rounded}, {absolute_gap_rounded}]")
EOF

def hp_filter(y, lamb=100):
    """
    Hodrick-Prescott filter implemented via matrix operations.
    Returns trend component.
    """
    n = len(y)
    
    # Create the second difference matrix D
    # D is (n-2) x n
    D = np.zeros((n-2, n))
    for i in range(n-2):
